item.title: Economic challenges in Germany and the future of Europe | Keynote speech at the Latvijas Banka Economic Conference 2026

rating.summary: Bundesbank President Nagel delivered a keynote at the Latvijas Banka Economic Conference 2026 focused on structural economic challenges facing Germany and the need for deeper European integration. The speech covers labor supply, energy transition, business environment reforms, and European financial integration including the digital euro and wholesale tokenized settlement. Monetary policy rates and interest rate decisions are not discussed.
rating.stance_rationale: The speech is primarily about structural and fiscal policy, European integration, and payment systems rather than monetary policy stance or interest rate direction, warranting a score of 0 and is_monetary_policy=false.
key_quotes: Fiscal policy is unlikely to noticeably raise growth potential.
The digital euro is currently envisaged to be rolled out for everyday payments as from the end of 2029.
